area: La Cresta Avenue area, southeast Bakersfield
disposition: treated as a firework; several neighbors called in the same boom
summary: Residents near La Cresta Avenue reported a loud boom they said was strong enough to shake doors open, and several neighbors called in the same blast shortly before 10 p.m. Crews treated it as a firework report.

disposition: reported stolen; firearm was inside at the time
summary: A white 2018 Freightliner semi truck was reported stolen from a property in northwest Bakersfield, with the owner saying a firearm was inside the cab when it was taken.

area: Wheeler Ridge Road near Berry Road, southwest Kern County
summary: A vehicle struck a horse in the Wheeler Ridge Road area and kept going, leaving the animal down in the roadway. Deputies went to the scene to confirm what happened.
A man in dark clothing was reported standing in the median along Union Avenue yelling threats, and the caller said he was holding a piece of sheet metal. Officers were sent to the scene.

disposition: no injuries; one driver taken into custody on suspicion of DUI
summary: A two-vehicle collision left both cars off the roadway shortly before midnight. No injuries were reported, and officers took one driver into custody on suspicion of driving under the influence.
A person in black clothing and a mask with a backpack was captured on surveillance outside a building near North Chester Avenue early Monday, then fled northwest behind the property.

area: 230th Street and Gaskell Avenue, southeast Kern County
summary: Deputies were sent to a property near 230th Street and Gaskell Avenue after three people in dark clothing were reported cutting through a chain-link fence toward heavy equipment and storage sheds, arriving in a pickup and an SUV pulling flatbed trailers.

area: Bernard Street at Jefferson Park, Bakersfield
summary: Officers were asked to check on a woman in the Bernard Street area near Jefferson Park whose friend reported hearing impact sounds in the background during a call.
